name: mouse_drag actually performs a click-and-hold-and-move drag (not just a click-in-place)
description: LIVE-only real-desktop regression test for `mouse_drag`/click-and-hold. Prior to this scenario, NOTHING in the automated suite (npm test / npm run eval) exercised `mouse_drag` or `input_hold` at all, so a fully green run gave zero signal about whether click-and-hold/drag actually works at the OS level. This launches a real Notepad window, uses UI Automation's TransformPattern to place it at an exact, known position (100,100)x(500,300) — same technique as 05b-ocr-live-notepad.json, chosen because it doesn't depend on window-manager/DPI assumptions — then calls `mouse_drag` to press the left button on the title bar, walk a multi-point path with a holdMs dwell at the end (exercising both the 'hold' and the 'move' halves of click-and-hold), and release. It then re-reads the window's actual on-screen position via UI Automation's BoundingRectangle and asserts it moved by (approximately) the exact drag delta. A drag that 'clicks and releases in place' without actually moving the window — the specific failure mode reported in manual testing — fails this scenario instead of passing silently.

args.command: Get-Process notepad -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process notepad; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1200; Write-Output 'launched'

Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient,UIAutomationTypes; $root = [System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::RootElement; $children = $root.FindAll([System.Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Children, [System.Windows.Automation.Condition]::TrueCondition); $target = $null; foreach ($w in $children) { if ($w.Current.Name -and $w.Current.Name.ToLower().Contains('notepad')) { $target = $w; break } }; if (-not $target) { Write-Output 'notfound'; exit 1 }; $tp = $target.GetCurrentPattern([System.Windows.Automation.TransformPattern]::Pattern); $tp.Move(100,100); $tp.Resize(500,300); Write-Output 'moved'

Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient,UIAutomationTypes; $root = [System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement]::RootElement; $children = $root.FindAll([System.Windows.Automation.TreeScope]::Children, [System.Windows.Automation.Condition]::TrueCondition); $target = $null; foreach ($w in $children) { if ($w.Current.Name -and $w.Current.Name.ToLower().Contains('notepad')) { $target = $w; break } }; if (-not $target) { Write-Output 'DRAG_OK:False (window not found)'; exit 0 }; $rect = $target.Current.BoundingRectangle; $dx = [Math]::Round($rect.X) - 100; $dy = [Math]::Round($rect.Y) - 100; $ok = ([Math]::Abs($dx - 200) -le 15) -and ([Math]::Abs($dy - 200) -le 15); Write-Output "DRAG_OK:$ok dx=$dx dy=$dy"
